extracted.name: Best Fruit Dip
extracted.description: This fruit dip with marshmallow and cream cheese is light, fluffy, and easy to make. Serve with your favorite fruit at parties, holidays, or any time!
instruction_lines: Gather cream cheese and marshmallow creme.
Place cream cheese and creme in a medium bowl
Blend cream cheese and marshmallow creme with an electric mixer until smooth and well combined.
